title: Installation Jobs Accounts Guidance: Company Date Moves and the Customer's Late Reschedule Fee
content:
**Accounts guidance — Ridgeline's own date moves and the late reschedule fee (Installation Jobs)**

Ridgeline's own moves of an **Installation Jobs** record lower the late reschedule fee billed for a customer reschedule on that job. The late reschedule fee for the reschedule is multiplied by a share charged that turns on how many times Ridgeline has moved a crew date of the job:

| Crew-date moves by Ridgeline recorded on the job | Share charged |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | zero (0), so nothing is owed |
| exactly one | one half (0.5) |
| none | one |

A move by Ridgeline is a reschedule recorded on the job as caused by the company. Reschedules caused by the customer or by the weather are not Ridgeline's moves and do not count here. All of the job's company reschedules count, whenever they were recorded.

## Basis Q&A

**Q. How much late reschedule fee is owed on a job whose crew date Ridgeline has moved two or more times?**
A. With two or more moves by Ridgeline the share charged is zero, so no late reschedule fee is owed.

**Q. What share of the fee is charged on a job whose crew date Ridgeline has moved exactly once?**
A. One half.

**Q. Does a weather reschedule count as a move by Ridgeline?**
A. No. Only reschedules recorded as caused by the company count.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A late reschedule fee figure of 190.00 is being priced on a job on which Ridgeline moved the crew date once. The share charged is one half, giving 95.00.
